profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience designing distributed systems and high-availability platforms. Passionate about delivering reliable, cost-optimized solutions that improve developer efficiency and customer experience.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
• Contributed to the design and deployment of a multi-region platform for over 40,000 retail services, achieving a 30% reduction in infrastructure costs.  
• Built configuration propagation and automated regional failover for 10,000 TPS traffic across three regions, ensuring seamless migrations.  
• Created an internal AWS SDK extension adopted by 2,000 services, significantly reducing onboarding time by 90% which provided better routing controls with safety and availability.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Software Infrastructure · Distributed Systems

positions.title: Software Development Engineer I
positions.description:
I successfully led the development of a real-time detection and triage platform that transformed operational response times.  

• Reduced Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR) from hours to 5 minutes with a 1-minute SLA.  
• Implemented automated regression testing across UI and backend services, enhancing software reliability.  
• Expanded compliance platform capabilities, achieving a 50% increase in compliance across 4 lines of business.
positions.insights: Skills: Leading Development Teams · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Node.js · JavaScript · Software Infrastructure

positions.title: Software Engineer, Machine Learning
positions.description:
• Automated expense reporting by developing a receipt understanding pipeline, achieving ~72% field-level extraction accuracy.  
• Reduced manual entry time to just 5 minutes per receipt, significantly enhancing operational efficiency.  
• Created an in-house ATS tracking system to ensure timely candidate responses within 7 business days.  
• Utilized a tech stack including Python, OpenCV, TensorFlow, AWS/OpenShift, and Kotlin for Android development.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
• Served as the integration lead engineer for MSM8940, overseeing critical integration tasks.  
• Assisted in integration duties for MDM9x65, ensuring seamless functionality across systems.  
• Engaged in bug triaging for both SoCs, enhancing product reliability and performance.  
• Developed skills in system integration, debugging, and collaborative problem-solving within a leading tech company.

positions.title: Associate Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborated as an integration engineer in the SoC integration team at Qualcomm.  
• Managed integration duties for multiple SoCs, including MSM8952 and MSM8976.  
• Acted as the primary point of contact between various SoC teams, enhancing communication and collaboration.  
• Developed technical skills in SoC integration and cross-functional teamwork.
